01 / About us

A senior team, not a rotating bench.

We started in 2016 with two engineers and one production incident too many. Today 28 of us work across four time zones, and the people who scope your system are the ones who build it.

Every engagement ends with your team able to run the work themselves: documented architecture, working pipelines, and a handover you can actually use.
